Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: PURPOSE: Restore a found set from a JSON array of PrimaryKeys, via the multi-key anchor relationship.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: PARAM: JSON array of PrimaryKey values, e.g. ["uuid-a","uuid-b",...]. Pass state.found_set directly.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: CONVENTION: Each entity has a base TO named "<Entity>Set" (ClientSet, VehicleSet, ...). Globals::FoundSetKeys is a global text field. The relationship Globals::FoundSetKeys = <Entity>Set::PrimaryKey makes FM resolve all matching records in O(1) regardless of set size.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ADDING a new entity: 1) create <Entity>Set TO. 2) add relationship Globals::FoundSetKeys = <Entity>Set::PrimaryKey. 3) add one Else If branch here. 4) done -- every layout sitting on <Entity>Set inherits found-set restore for free.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: LAYOUTS NOT FOLLOWING THE CONVENTION: silent no-op (the trailing Else falls through). Their found set is not restored.

Step.name: Insert Text
Step.Text: PARAMETER FORMAT: JSON array of PrimaryKey strings. Example: ["uuid-a","uuid-b","uuid-c"] EXIT RESULT: Get(FoundCount) after restore, or "" on no-op.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Stage the anchor: ¶-delimited PK list goes into the global text field that drives every entity relationship.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Per-entity GTRR. From-table is a static reference in FM; target layout stays current via CurrentLayout.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Base TO does not follow the <Entity>Set convention -- no found-set restore available. Silent no-op.
